audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Diana/Skill/Skill while content win[] and the packet chart both read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Neeko/Diana/Diana. Level 6 was the worst of them: the side said Diana while the why underneath it described Neeko's Pop Blossom winning the stage, and win[4] says Neeko.
audit.why: Diana has no gap-closer before Lunar Rush, so levels 1-3 belong to Neeko. Levels 4-5 even out on Pale Cascade value. Level 6 favours Neeko because Pop Blossom is instant and Moonfall has a wind-up at 475 range. Past first item her shields plus a resetting dash beat one burst rotation.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 Neeko, row 3 Skill (unchanged), row 4 Neeko, rows 5-6 Diana; whys rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic "Level 3 / level 6 / Luden's" line and never named her spike at all.
audit.why: Her spike is items plus shields: E into R with Pale Cascade absorbing the answer, and Lunar Rush resetting off the kill.
audit.corrected: Level 3 root-bloom is the kill pattern; level 6 counters her jump; her item all-in flips it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said "Moonlight marks reset her dash" but never stated the actual rule, and breakdown.cooldowns carried no digit (defect catalogue item 3).
audit.why: Riot's own text: Lunar Rush has NO cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight, and Crescent Strike is what applies Moonlight. So the arc, not the dash, is the thing to dodge — unmarked, Lunar Rush is 22/20/18/16/14 at 825 range. Pale Cascade is 15/13.5/12/10.5/9 and its third sphere strengthens the shield. Moonfall is only 475 range.
audit.corrected: Lunar Rush is 22s at rank 1 but free onto anything Crescent Strike has marked — dodge the arc and the dash goes back on cooldown; trade after Pale Cascade's shield pops; stay outside 475-range Moonfall.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E/R text, cooldowns and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the cooldowns field.
audit.why: The punishable window is a Crescent Strike that missed: with no mark on you, her dash is a 22s cooldown at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers added for Lunar Rush, Pale Cascade and Moonfall's range.
